recognize_zh: 上方骨髓切片（H&E）與下方抹片中的巨核細胞，細胞核都是單一圓形、不分葉且偏於一側，細胞質豐富，是 del(5q) MDS 典型的非分葉巨核細胞（non-lobated megakaryocytes）。
features: Upper panel (H&E biopsy): megakaryocytes with single round to oval non-lobated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Upper panel background: clusters of erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei near fat spaces
Lower panel (aspirate smear): two megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and single eccentric round nuclei
Megakaryocytes are normal to slightly reduced in size, not micromegakaryocytes
Adjacent platelets and platelet clumps in the aspirate background
describe_en: Composite of a bone marrow core biopsy section (H&E, upper) and aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, lower). In the biopsy, megakaryocytes with single round to oval non-lobated nuclei and abundant cytoplasm are seen among erythroid precursors. The aspirate shows two megakaryocytes of near-normal size with abundant granular cytoplasm and single, eccentric, round nuclei, with nearby platelet clumps. Non-lobated or hypolobated megakaryocytes of normal to slightly reduced size are the characteristic finding of myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q), and the findings are consistent with that diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small with scant cytoplasm and a single small nucleus, whereas del(5q) megakaryocytes retain normal size and abundant cytoplasm.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters.
Other MDS show megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes rather than one compact round nucleus.
Immature forms have scant basophilic cytoplasm and high N:C ratio rather than abundant mature granular cytoplasm.
